description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based database visualizer dashboard. It contains the structure, styles, and client-side JavaScript code to browse databases, tables, and data, providing interactive features like refresh, expand cells, and dynamic data loading via API calls.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by reloading data from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables under a selected database, loading tables if needed.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data from a selected table and renders it in a table format with expandable cells.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates an HTML table to display the data records.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Formats data cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expand functionality.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content or truncated preview.
